name: _cms_fts_notes_v3
sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "_cms_fts_notes_v3" USING fts5(
				id UNINDEXED, locale UNINDEXED, title, body,
				tokenize='porter unicode61'
			)

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_config
sql: CREATE TABLE '_cms_fts_notes_v3_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_content
sql: CREATE TABLE '_cms_fts_notes_v3_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3)

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_data
sql: CREATE TABLE '_cms_fts_notes_v3_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "_cms_fts_notes_v3_delete"
			AFTER DELETE ON "ec_notes_v3"
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM "_cms_fts_notes_v3" WHERE rowid = OLD.rowid;
			END

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_docsize
sql: CREATE TABLE '_cms_fts_notes_v3_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_idx
sql: CREATE TABLE '_cms_fts_notes_v3_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_insert
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "_cms_fts_notes_v3_insert"
			AFTER INSERT ON "ec_notes_v3"
			WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NULL
			BEGIN
				INSERT OR REPLACE INTO "_cms_fts_notes_v3"(rowid, id, locale, title, body)
				VALUES (NEW.rowid, NEW.id, NEW.locale, NEW.title, CASE WHEN NEW.body IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN json_valid(NEW.body) AND json_type(NEW.body) IN ('array', 'object') THEN (SELECT group_concat(j.value, ' ') FROM json_tree(NEW.body) AS j WHERE j.key IN ('text', 'alt', 'caption', 'code') AND j.type = 'text') ELSE NEW.body END);
			END

name: _cms_fts_notes_v3_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "_cms_fts_notes_v3_update"
			AFTER UPDATE ON "ec_notes_v3"
			WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NEW.deleted_at OR OLD.locale IS NOT NEW.locale OR OLD.title IS NOT NEW.title OR OLD.body IS NOT NEW.body
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM "_cms_fts_notes_v3" WHERE rowid = OLD.rowid;
				INSERT INTO "_cms_fts_notes_v3"(rowid, id, locale, title, body)
				SELECT NEW.rowid, NEW.id, NEW.locale, NEW.title, CASE WHEN NEW.body IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN json_valid(NEW.body) AND json_type(NEW.body) IN ('array', 'object') THEN (SELECT group_concat(j.value, ' ') FROM json_tree(NEW.body) AS j WHERE j.key IN ('text', 'alt', 'caption', 'code') AND j.type = 'text') ELSE NEW.body END
				WHERE NEW.deleted_at IS NULL;
			END
